samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">Divide state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="dividend_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the dividend.</reg>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" width_description="[7:0]">Register to hold the divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">Register to hold the negative divisor.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt">Start counter flag.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter for iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg">Result valid flag.</reg>
        <reg id="result_reg" width_description="[15:0]">Register to hold the result.</reg>
        <reg id="sr_carry_out">Shift register carry-out.</reg>
        <wire id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Wire to hold the subtraction result.</wire>
        <wire id="mux_out" width_description="[8:0]">Wire to hold the mux output.</wire>
        <wire id="sr_in" width_description="[8:0]">Wire to hold the shift register input.</wire>
        <assign id="SR[8]" src="sub_result[9]"/>
        <assign id="SR[7:0]" src="mux_out[7:0]"/>
        <assign id="sub_result" src="SR + neg_divisor"/>
        <assign id="mux_out" src="{sr_carry_out, sub_result[8:1]}"/>
        <assign id="sr_in" src="mux_out"/>
        <always_comb>
            case(cnt)
                4'd0: sr_carry_out = ~sub_result[9];
                default: sr_carry_out = sub_result[9];
            endcase
        end
        <always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)> 
            if(rst) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                result_reg <= 16'd0;
            end else begin
                if(opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                    dividend_reg <= dividend;
                    divisor_reg <= divisor;
                    neg_divisor <= {~|divisor, ~divisor}+1'b1;
                    SR <= {dividend, 1'b0};
                    cnt <= 4'd1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end else if(start_cnt) begin
                    if(&cnt) begin
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        res_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
                        result_reg <= {SR[8], SR[7:0]};
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        SR <= sr_in;
                    end
                end else begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implements a simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</implementation>
</module>
